ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (at times referred to as the "Agreement"), made as of the 1 3th day of July 201 3,by and between Antonio Castro,an individual residing at 1071 Hall Place, Bronx, New York (at times referred to herein as “Castro "), and 1075 Hall Place LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an address at 1559 49th Street, Brooklyn, New York 11219 (at times referred to herein as “"Hall Place"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Castro is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Bronx and County of Bronx,City and State of New York,generally known as and by thestreet address1071 Hall Place,Bronx,NY,and designated asTax Lot 94 in Block 2691 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Bronx County (the “Tax Map") and more particularly described on Exhibit “A” annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Land." said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if any, and any future replacements or new buildings constructed thereon being herein referred to as the “Parcel A Building." and the Parcel A Land and the Parcel A Building being at times herein collectively referred to as “Parcel A." and the owner of Parcel A, and its successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at times collectively as “Parcel A Owner"); WHEREAS,Hall Place is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,in theBoroughof Bronx andCountyof Bronx,CityandStateofNewYork, generally known as and by the street address 1075 Hall Place, Bronx, New York, and designated as Tax Lot 92 in Block 2691 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit “B" annexed hereto and made a part hereof (such land being herein collectively referred to as the "Parcel B Land.," said buildings and improvements located thereon as of the date hereof, if referred to as the “"Parcel B Building." andtheParcel B Land, theParcel B Building being at timeshereincollectivelyreferred toas“ParcelB",andtheownerofParcelB,andits successors and assigns, shall be referred to herein at timesas"ParcelB Owner", and attimes ParcelA Ownerand Parcel B Ownerarereferred toherein individually as a“Party” orcollectively, asthe"Parties"); WHEREAS, Parcel B Owner intends to construct a new building on Parcel B with a bulk in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Parcel B under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) if Parcel B were to be considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) which are appurtenant to Parcel A, if Parcel A were considered as a separate and independent zoning lot, that are in excess of the Retained Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), which are available for transferpursuant totheZoningResolution;
